decisions.reason: Having survived the early portfolio shake-out among several 2018 handle launches, this close-to-core handle family likely earns its place in the firm's broad range, so the option value of keeping it remains higher than the low carrying cost of continuation.

As a design-oriented core product it still fits the firm's positioning, but individual handle designs are easier to replace or rationalize once market feedback is known, so the risk of withdrawal is somewhat higher than for a broader family.

This electronic access system matches the firm's stated move toward digital building organization and appears to have received continued attention after launch, so despite higher complexity it retains strong strategic option value and should be kept.
